title: Memorial Tower Editing Guide
summary: Editing guide for the Memorial Tower insulation project footage.
content:
Memorial Tower - Editing Guide

Client: Ambition Mechanical Services Project: Memorial Tower (Insulation) Resolve Project: Ambition 2026 (Resolve Cloud) Shoot Dates: 8 sessions spanning Aug 2025 to Jan 2026 Total Non-Proxy Video Clips: ~354 Total DJI MIC Recordings: 9 files across 4 dates Generated: 2026-03-12

Overview

Memorial Tower is Ambition's most documented job site with 8 shoot dates over 6 months. This gives massive before/after and progression potential. The footage spans from early project phases (Aug 2025) through active insulation work (Jan 2026).

Cameras Used:

  • DJI Drone (4K, h264/hevc, 24fps/60fps)
  • DJI Ronin 4D (4K DCI / 4K UHD, h264/prores, 24fps/60fps)
  • Panasonic S5 IIX (6K/4K, hevc/h264, 24fps/60fps)
  • BlackMagic Camera App / iPhone (4K ProRes / 1080p h264, 24fps/30fps)
  • DJI MIC (48kHz, 32-bit float WAV, mono)

Content Ideas (Ranked by Impact)

1. Project Progression Reel (HIGHEST IMPACT)

Source: Drone footage from all dates (Aug 2025 > Sep 2025 > Jan 2026)

  • 8 visits over 6 months = powerful before/during/after story
  • Match drone angles across dates to show transformation
  • This is the showcase piece. 60-90 seconds. LinkedIn + IG.
  • Use iPhone clips from each date as quick reference markers.

2. Interview/Testimonial Cut

Source: The talking clips from Jan 8, 13, 14, 21

  • C0024 from 0108 (4:20), B002C0012+C0013 from 0113 (10 min combined), B003C0018+C0024 from 0114 (10 min combined), and the BlackMagic clips from 0121
  • Sync DJI MIC audio for clean voiceover on all talking clips
  • Could be crew talking about the project, or the building manager, or Ambition team discussing the work
  • Cut into a testimonial or "the story of this project" narrative

3. Crew at Work Reels (Multiple)

Source: Short b-roll clips from all Ronin4D shoots

  • Hundreds of 3-15 second b-roll clips of insulation work
  • Speed ramp, cut to music, add text overlays
  • "Watch us insulate a 20-story building" type content
  • Great for IG Reels and TikTok. Multiple reels from this pool.

4. Drone Showcase

Source: 40+ minutes of drone footage across 3 dates

  • Building exterior from every angle
  • Before (Aug) vs After (Jan) aerials
  • Cinematic orbits, reveals, flyovers
  • LinkedIn: professional, impressive scale
  • The 60fps drone footage from 0108 can be slowed to 24fps for cinematic feel

5. 6K Detail Reel

Source: S5 IIX 5952x3968 footage from 20250908

  • Highest resolution footage in the project
  • Crop/reframe to create multiple compositions from single shots
  • Best for detail-focused content: tools, hands, materials, textures

6. Day in the Life

Source: Full day coverage from Jan 8 or Jan 13+14 (back to back days)

  • Morning arrival (7 AM clips) through afternoon work
  • Multiple cameras, drone, handheld
  • Show the scale and effort of commercial insulation

7. Educational/Process Content

Source: Close-up b-roll from Ronin4D across all Jan dates

  • "How commercial insulation works" series
  • Show materials, tools, techniques
  • Educational content performs well on LinkedIn for construction vertical

8. BTS/Behind the Camera

Source: iPhone clips (IMG_8570, 8576, 8579, 8581, 8584)

  • Quick authentic BTS content
  • "We were here documenting the work" angle
  • Good for Stories or quick social posts

Recommended Edit Structures

Project Showcase (60-90s)

  1. Drone establishing (5s)
  2. Text overlay: project name + scope
  3. Quick b-roll montage (15s, 2-3s clips each)
  4. Interview soundbite (10-15s)
  5. Work sequence (15s)
  6. Drone progression (before/after, 10s)
  7. Interview closer (5-10s)
  8. End card with Ambition branding

Social Reel (15-30s)

  1. Hook: dramatic drone or close-up detail (2s)
  2. Fast b-roll cuts to music (10-20s, 1-2s each)
  3. Text CTA or branding (3s)

Long-form (2-5 min)

  1. Cold open with best soundbite
  2. Drone establishing
  3. "The challenge" section (interview + wide shots)
  4. "The work" section (b-roll montage, process shots)
  5. "The result" section (final state + drone)
  6. Testimonial/closing
  7. Ambition branding

Technical Notes for Resolve

Mixed Frame Rates

  • Ronin 4D: 24fps (Jan 2026) and 59.94fps (Aug-Sep 2025)
  • Drone: Mix of 23.98fps, 24fps, and 59.94fps
  • S5 IIX: 23.98fps (Sep 2025) and 59.94fps (Jan 2026)
  • iPhone: 30fps
  • BlackMagic App: 24fps
  • Recommendation: Set Resolve timeline to 24fps. Interpret 60fps clips as slo-mo when needed, or conform to 24.

Mixed Resolutions

  • 4096x2160 (DCI 4K, Ronin 4D Aug/Sep)
  • 3840x2160 (UHD 4K, everything else)
  • 5952x3968 (6K, S5 IIX Sep 2025)
  • 1920x1080 (iPhone clips)
  • Recommendation: Timeline at 3840x2160. The 4096 and 6K clips give room to reframe.

Codec Mix

  • ProRes (Jan 2026 Ronin 4D + BlackMagic) - heaviest to decode, best quality
  • H.264 (Aug-Sep Ronin 4D, Drone, iPhone)
  • HEVC/H.265 (Jan 2026 Drone, Sep S5 IIX)
  • Recommendation: Use Resolve's Optimized Media for the ProRes and HEVC clips if timeline is sluggish.

Proxy Files

Every shoot date has /Proxy/ subfolders with lower-res versions for editing. Use these in Resolve if real-time playback is needed, then switch to full-res for export.

DJI MIC Audio

  • 48kHz, 32-bit float, mono WAV
  • These are clean lavalier recordings. Use as primary audio on talking clips.
  • Scratch audio from camera = reference only when DJI MIC is available.

Gaps and Issues

  1. No DJI MIC on Aug 10, Sep 8, Jan 21, or Jan 22. Talking clips from these dates rely entirely on camera scratch audio.
  2. Jan 22 has only 1 iPhone clip. Minimal coverage. Only useful as a progression data point.
  3. Jan 21 BlackMagic clips use AAC audio. Quality is lower than PCM from Ronin 4D. May need noise reduction.
  4. 60fps clips from Aug/Sep Ronin 4D may look different in motion than 24fps Jan clips. Be aware of the visual difference when intercutting.
  5. S5 IIX 6K footage needs scaling. Will be slower to decode. Consider proxies.
  6. Some clips have no audio data (volumedetect returned empty). These are likely very short clips where ffmpeg couldn't complete the analysis. They're b-roll, not talking.
  7. DJI MIC timing for 0108 afternoon doesn't fully align with video timestamps. MIC files end at ~19:03 UTC but afternoon video session starts at 19:45 UTC. There's a 42-min gap. The afternoon talking clips (C0113-C0124) may not have DJI MIC coverage. See sync map for details.
  8. AUDIO folder in 20250908 contains pre-rendered edits, not raw audio. These suggest previous editing work was done on this footage. Check with Patrik on whether to build on the existing edit or start fresh.
